summary: Sun 03 Aug 2026. DA3-Streaming PHASES 3+4 GREEN on HF. da3-stream preset poses ALL 500 frames (vs 80 for da3-standard) - 6.25x - then trains through the UNCHANGED Job B contract. SfM: 500/500 posed, 120.3s inference, a10g-small, ~0.04 USD. Training: l4x1, 1316.8s + 44s export, ~0.32 USD, 956,304 gaussians. Render shows visibly sharper architecture than any prior run (shed turquoise door, wall texture, window opening all resolve with real edges). Built the whole container path: Dockerfile vendors da3_streaming with --recurse-submodules (salad submodule mandatory), adds 7 undeclared deps + transitive, faiss-cpu for the module-scope import, plus TWO new build-time assertions (torch/numpy intact, and full streaming import chain) that would have caught every phase-1 blocker for free. New --stream-sfm entrypoint mode: resize, stage weights from Hub, generate config, run streaming with live output, convert, bundle. THREE bugs found by running it: (1) IRLS.tol and SIM3_Optimizer.lambda_init must be emitted as STRINGS because streaming eval()s them - works for their YAML since PyYAML/YAML-1.1 needs a dot in exponents so 1e-9 is a string, but yaml.safe_dump of a Python float writes 1.0e-09 which round-trips as a real float and eval(float) TypeErrors; local run passed only because that config was hand-written. (2) I defined run_streaming twice, shadowing the existing helper and breaking every --train-only call site 15s into a scheduled GPU job - added tests/test_entrypoint_hygiene.py catching duplicate top-level defs, mutation-tested. (3) flavor_scheduling_timeout_seconds was only honoured by the direct-GS path so the split path silently used 120s and burned a launch - now a shared _scheduling_timeout helper across all four remote StageContexts.
